name: Crab Season

angles.text: As a cook, you can prepare seasonal Windsong crawler meat gathered from Zephras’s lake.

faq.answer: Windsong crawlers are aggressive crabs found only around Windsong Lake on Zephras. They can be gathered for just a few weeks each year.
Windsong crawlers are available for only a few weeks each year. Once the season closes, their meat cannot be gathered again until the next year.
faq.q: Why do the crabs need to be harvested right now?

faq.answer: Cultist activity has made the journey to Windsong Lake too dangerous for local foragers to make before the short season ends.
faq.q: Why can't the local harvester gather the crabs themselves?

faq.answer: Windsong crawlers live along the shores of Windsong Lake on Zephras and the nearby connecting riverbanks.
Windsong crawlers are aggressive and snap at anyone trying to gather them.
faq.q: Are Windsong crawlers dangerous to hunt?

faq.answer: Locals gather Windsong crawler meat as seasonal food during the few weeks it is available. Cultists blocking the paths have led them to seek help from adventurers.
faq.q: What is Windsong crawler meat used for?

sections.body: For a few weeks each year, Windsong crawlers appear along Windsong Lake’s freshwater shores and the rivers that feed it. Their meat is a rare harvest, but the season soon passes.
sections.title: A Fleeting Harvest

sections.body: Cultists patrol the wilderness around Zephras, putting local foragers in danger. The journey to Windsong Lake is too hazardous for gatherers alone. Unless you brave the shores and the ill-tempered crabs, this brief harvest may be lost.
sections.title: Peril by the Waters

summary: On Zephras, foragers hurry to gather Windsong crawlers before the brief season ends. Cultists have made the shores perilous, so locals call for help.
